protocol_metadata.about: Suilend is the largest lending protocol on Sui, launched in March 2024 by the team behind Save (formerly Solend). It enables users to deposit assets to earn interest and borrow against collateral, with features including isolated lending pools, leverage trading, liquid staking via SpringSui, and a superfluid AMM called STEAMM. SEND is the governance token distributed through mdrop mechanism and will govern DAO decisions.
